name: Phorusrhacos Le Vueltoraptor
original_name: フォルスラコス・レ・ヴェルトラプトル
source:
"O-ni-san, it seems like you're being crushed with one hand..."

The cafeteria chef at the academy. He is very popular with students because of his friendly demeanor and cheerfulness.

He's a top-notch cook, but he has a bad habit of making strange dishes all of a sudden and using dormitory students as test subjects. Even if you open your mouth, you'll say too much. If you don't understand the TPO, you'll be called a sexual harasser by female students.

He's not on good terms with [url=https://vndb.org/c43558]Gessy[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111116203410/http://senz.jp/chara/chara6.html]official website[/url]]
